subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. 

**Cursory**
solution:
The correct answer is "**Thorough**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is "**Cursory**".
 
• "**Cursory**" means done in a quick and superficial way, without giving much attention to detail. (सरसरी / सतही)
 
 
• **Example**: The officer made only a cursory inspection of the documents.
 
 
 
• "**Thorough**" means complete, detailed, and careful in every aspect. (गहन / पूरी तरह से किया गया)
 
 
• **Example**: The detective conducted a thorough investigation before reaching a conclusion.
 
 
 
• Hence, "**Thorough**" is the most appropriate antonym of "**Cursory**".

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Brief**: Lasting for a short time or using few words. (संक्षिप्त)
 
• **Hasty**: Done with excessive speed and without sufficient thought or care. (जल्दबाज़ी में किया गया)
 
• **Superficial**: Existing or occurring at the surface; lacking depth or careful thought. (सतही)

4c:T9a9,

The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Skillful**.
